workflow_runs.name: blob-size-policy
workflow_runs.display_title: [codex] Add /create-api-key to app-server TUI

head_commit.message:
Move app-server API key creation server-side

Run the browser OAuth/key-minting flow in the app-server, then attach the minted key to the target thread's dependency env directly. Keep the TUI app-server client responsible only for opening the auth URL, rendering status, and copying the returned key to the clipboard.

Replace the generic dependency-env RPCs with create-api-key-specific start/finish RPCs, update protocol schemas/docs, and reuse the shared codex-login callback flow by exposing shutdown hooks for abandoned pending sessions.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
